result.description:
Business Analyst – Preston VIC

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters, are working with a long-established and successful furniture retailer based in Preston, VIC. The company specialises in premium indoor and outdoor furniture, including sofas, dining furniture, bedroom suites, recliners, and home décor. With multiple retail showrooms, a growing eCommerce presence, and a commitment to exceptional customer experiences, our client is seeking an experienced and qualified Business Analyst to support the continued growth and business transformation.

About the Role:

The new Business Analyst will work across retail, eCommerce, supply chain and operational functions. The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders to analyse business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver technology and operational initiatives that enhance efficiency, customer experience and business performance.

•	Tenure – The role is full time and ongoing.

•	Location – Preston VIC

•	Salary – Salary, negotiable in the range of $80k to $90k plus superannuation per annum.

Responsibilities will include:

•	Engage with stakeholders across the business to gather, document and analyse business requirements.

•	Review existing business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and automation.

•	Analyse sales, inventory, customer and operational data to support strategic decision-making.

•	Develop business cases, functional specifications, process maps and workflow documentation.

•	Liaise with software vendors, developers and internal stakeholders during system implementation and enhancement projects.

•	Support the implementation of ERP, CRM, eCommerce and other business systems.

•	Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) and coordinate system testing activities.

•	Prepare reports, dashboards and performance metrics to support business objectives.

•	Assist with change management, user training and post-implementation reviews.

•	Ensure solutions align with business objectives and industry best practice.

To be successful in this role you will have:

•	A bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Business, Information Technology, Business Information Systems or a closely related discipline.
•	At least one years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst in a similar setting.

•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

•	Proficiency with specific software tools (e.g., ERP systems, WMS, TMS), data analysis tools like Excel, SQL, or BI platforms.

•	Experience documenting business requirements, process mapping and business process improvement.

•	Experience working with ERP, CRM, retail or eCommerce systems will be highly regarded.

•	Advanced communication and documentation skills.

•	A results-driven mindset with a focus on improving company outcomes while achieving personal and team objectives.

•	Ability to multitask and prioritise in a fast-paced environment.

•	Solid references.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and analytical ICT Business and Systems Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders to understand operational requirements, analyse existing systems, and deliver technology solutions that improve efficiency, productivity, and business performance.

You will act as the bridge between business needs and technical implementation by gathering requirements, documenting processes, and supporting the successful delivery of ICT projects.

Key Responsibilities

Consult with stakeholders to identify business needs and system requirements.
Analyse current business processes and recommend technology-driven improvements.
Gather, document and validate functional and technical requirements.
Prepare business requirement documents, process maps, user stories and functional specifications.
Work closely with software developers, project managers and third-party vendors to implement solutions.
Perform system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT) and quality assurance activities.
Assist with system integration, deployment and post-implementation support.
Analyse data and prepare reports to support business decision-making.
Develop user documentation, training materials and standard operating procedures.
Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation.
Monitor system performance and recommend ongoing improvements.
Ensure solutions comply with organisational policies, security requirements and industry best practices.

Skills & Experience

Minimum two years' experience as an ICT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst or similar role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
Knowledge of business process modelling techniques.
Experience with SQL, databases and reporting tools is desirable.
Understanding of SDLC, Agile and/or Waterfall methodologies.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong documentation and presentation abilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
Desirable
Experience with ERP, CRM or enterprise software platforms.
Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Power BI or business intelligence tools.
Exposure to cloud technologies and API integrations.
Experience within digital transformation or software implementation projects.
What We Offer

Competitive salary package of $80k - 95k

Career development and professional growth opportunities.
Collaborative and supportive work environment.
Opportunity to work on innovative ICT and digital transformation projects.
Flexible working arrangements where applicable.

result.description:
Our client, OSMO Creations, transforms ideas into impactful outcomes through design, storytelling, and innovation. As a multidisciplinary creative studio based in Australia, they operate at the crossroads of strategy, design, and technology. From their headquarters in Para Hills West, South Australia, they bring together Designers, Producers, Filmmakers, and digital specialists to deliver outstanding, integrated solutions.

They are now looking for a Digital Production Manager to join their creative team. In this role, you will act as the vital link between creative vision and seamless delivery, managing the end-to-end production of digital content assets, including video, motion graphics, and interactive experiences, while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with brand standards.

The annual salary for the Digital Production Manager is $80,000 to $81,000 plus superannuation.

Duties include:

•	Lead project planning: scope, timeline, resource allocation, budget.

•	Liaise with creative teams (Designers, Editors, Animators, Developers) to ensure deliverables meet the creative brief.

•	Manage production workflows: pre-production, shoot/asset capture, post-production, delivery.

•	Maintain high-quality standards and brand consistency across all outputs.

•	Anticipate and resolve production risks and bottlenecks.

•	Track project metrics and provide status updates to stakeholders.

•	Continuously optimise production processes for efficiency and scalability.

•	Collaborate closely with clients and account teams to interpret creative briefs and translate them into actionable production plans.

•	Oversee vendor relationships, including freelance creatives, post-production partners, and technical suppliers, ensuring deliverables meet OSMO’s standards.

•	Implement and maintain digital asset management systems and file-naming conventions to streamline workflow and ensure version control.

•	Drive innovation in production processes by exploring new tools, software, and emerging technologies that enhance creativity and efficiency.

•	Support business development by providing production insights, timelines, and cost estimates during pitches and proposal stages.

Qualifications:

•	Must have at least two (2) years of relevant experience.

•	Should hold at least an AQF Bachelor or higher qualification, or equivalent qualifications and have at least 2 years of recent and relevant work experience; or 5 years of relevant work experience may substitute for a qualification.

•	Should have at least one (1) year of relevant work experience where the relevant AQF qualification was obtained in Australia; or have at least two (2) years of relevant work experience.

About Us
We are a rapidly growing engineering consulting firm with over 15 years of specialized expertise in structural, civil and stormwater engineering. We deliver precision engineering design and documentation services for residential (low to mid-rise), commercial, industrial and modular buildings across New South Wales.
Our reputation has been built on technical excellence, attention to detail and seamless collaboration with architects, developers, builders and consultants. Our mission is to provide practical, efficient and innovative engineering solutions that stand the test of time.
The Role
An exciting opportunity has become available for a Stormwater Engineer to join our growing team in Sydney.
You will be responsible for preparing stormwater management designs and supporting documentation for residential and commercial developments, while working closely with our structural and civil engineering teams.
The ideal candidate is motivated, detail-oriented, able to manage multiple projects, and committed to delivering high-quality engineering solutions.
Key Responsibilities
•	Prepare stormwater drainage designs for residential, commercial and industrial developments.
•	Design On-Site Detention (OSD), rainwater harvesting and stormwater management systems.
•	Prepare Stormwater Management Reports (SMR) and supporting engineering documentation.
•	Liaise with councils, architects, builders, certifiers and other consultants.
•	Assist with Development Application (DA) and Construction Certificate (CC) submissions.
•	Ensure designs comply with Australian Standards, council requirements and relevant engineering guidelines.
•	Coordinate with structural and civil engineers throughout project delivery.
•	Assist with project planning and delivery within required timeframes.
Key Requirements
•	Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline.
•	Experience in stormwater engineering and drainage design.
•	Proficient in AutoCAD.
•	Experience with Drains, MUSIC, DRAINS, HEC-RAS or other stormwater modelling software is highly regarded.
•	Good understanding of Australian Standards, Australian Rainfall & Runoff (ARR), and local council stormwater requirements.
•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills.
•	Ability to work both independently and within a team.
•	Attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
•	Need minimum 1.5 years working experience
•	Current Australian Driver Licence is preferred.
•	Visa status: Australian Citizen, Permanent Resident (PR), or full working rights in Australia.
What We Offer
•	Competitive salary based on experience.
•	Professional development and ongoing training.
•	Opportunity to work on a diverse range of engineering projects.
•	Supportive and collaborative team environment.
•	Career progression within a growing engineering consultancy.
•	Salary packaging.
